artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: La servante
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a bedroom. The setting features a richly furnished room with a detailed bed, elegant drapery, and decorative elements. A painting hangs on the wall and there is an object on the floor. The artwork showcases opulence and historical style through intricate details and shading techniques.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: La servante
artworks.artist: Philippe Triere and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: There are three individuals in the image. Two women stand beside a bed. One woman is leaning forward, holding something. They both wear bonnets and long dresses. A man sits in the bed, propped up by pillows, wearing a nightcap. The room is lavishly decorated with a canopy bed, artwork on the wall, and ornate decorations. A decorative object rests on the floor near the bed.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le poirier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a garden with lush foliage and detailed architecture in the background. Tools such as a shovel and a hoe are on the ground near bushes and flowers. A large tree dominates part of the scene, adding depth. In the background, there is an elegant building and a sculptural element. The drawing is detailed, showcasing the elements within the scene in a realistic manner.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le poirier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene near a garden. The image depicts a countryside setting with a large tree dominating the mid-ground. Under the tree, a couple is lounging on the ground. More trees and bushes are on the right side, and in the background is a building with a stone wall topped with statues. Garden tools and fruits are also depicted in the scene. The drawing style is intricate and delicate, focusing on light and shade.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le poirier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting nature and architecture. In the foreground, a couple is reclining on the ground surrounded by lush foliage. Above them, in the branches of a large tree, another figure seems to be perched. To the left, a building with classical architecture sits in the background, with a bridge or entryway extending towards the viewer. Various objects like a hat and basket are included in the scene. The drawing is detailed with an emphasis on textures of foliage and fabric.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le poirier
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two people, a man and a woman, are lying on the grass under a tree, embracing each other. The woman wears a light-colored dress with ruffled sleeves, and the man has short, curly hair. They appear to be kissing. Nearby, there is a basket of fruit, a jug, gardening tools, and a hat on the ground. Above the couple, a man is in a tree, dressed in period clothing and observing them. In the background, there is an estate with a grand building, statues, and a garden.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le fil
artworks.description: Two individuals are present in the image. One person is lying on a bed covered with bedding, while the other person is standing with a lamp in hand. The individual on the bed appears to be asleep. The second person is wearing a robe or nightgown and is holding a small lamp, with their head covered by a fabric turban. The setting is a lavish bedroom with large curtains, a partially open door, and paneled walls.

artworks.title: La gageure des trois commeres: Le fil
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a room. One person is lying on a bed, visible from head to toe. They are reclining on a luxurious bed draped with elaborate curtains, with eyes closed, possibly asleep, and partially covered with a soft, light garment. The other person is standing nearby holding an oil lamp in a raised hand, casting light in the dimly lit room. This person is dressed in a tunic with a cloth wrapped around their head. The background shows a richly decorated room with heavy drapery, a patterned carpet, and subtle architectural details suggesting a sophisticated interior.

artworks.title: Le calendrier des viellards
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals sitting closely together. The man and woman are seated on a divan or bench, with the woman leaning towards the man and the man placing his arm over the back of the seating area. The woman has elaborate hair with a decorative element or small hat, while the man wears a turban or cloth wrapped around his head. The woman's dress is ornate with ruffles and layered fabric, extending down to her feet. The man wears flowing robes. Both individuals exude elegance and refinement. The room features opulent floral wallpaper, a large oval picture or mirror framed elaborately above them, and a decorative fabric chair with floral details and a bouquet. A table to the left holds small containers, possibly dressing or makeup items.

artworks.title: Le calendrier des viellards
artworks.description: The image contains an engraving of two individuals from the waist up in an ornate interior. The woman is seated to the left, leaning towards the man on her right, with his arm around her shoulders. She has curly hair styled in an intricate updo and wears a flowery hat. The man’s face is partially hidden by his position, wearing a headwrap and draped garment. His hand points to a framed calendar on the wall. The room is lavishly decorated with patterned wallpaper and ornate furnishings. A draped table with small containers is on the left, and a chair with a floral arrangement is on the right. A portrait hangs above the couple, and a cat sits beside the chair.

artworks.title: Le calendrier des viellards
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated on a decorative bench. One person is a woman with curly hair wearing a ruffled gown and holding a bouquet of flowers. The person next to her is an older man with a robe and head covering, pointing towards decorative furniture. The background features an ornately decorated room with textured walls, curtains, and a table with bottles.

artworks.title: Le calendrier des viellards
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with two people sitting closely together on a plush chair. The woman on the left has soft facial features and curls in her hair, wearing a gown with lace details and ruffles. The man beside her has a defined facial structure and is wearing a turban-like headpiece and loose attire. The setting includes elaborate wallpaper, a framed relief or painting in the background, heavy drapery, a carved chair, a floral bouquet, and a small table displaying household items. The room conveys an impression of elegance and opulence.

artworks.title: A femme avare galant escroc
artworks.artist: Jacques Aliamet and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a man in an intimate domestic setting. The woman is standing slightly forward while the man is seated on a sofa, reaching out to embrace her. The woman's face is turned slightly to the side, showing delicate features and styled hair. She is wearing an elaborate dress, typical of 18th-century fashion. The man has a similar hairstyle and is dressed in a suit. The room is decorated with a carved wooden desk, framed artworks, a small dog, and scattered flowers.

artworks.title: A femme avare galant escroc
artworks.artist: Jacques Aliamet and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man indoors. The woman stands beside a desk holding a small object, while the man is seated on a sofa embracing her waist. The woman has curly hair and wears an elaborate dress, while the man has curly hair as well and is dressed in formal attire. The room has framed paintings and ornate wall decorations, with furniture and a small dog present. The background is richly decorated.

artworks.title: On ne s'avise jamais de tout
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a domestic scene. The interior setting shows a lively scene unfolding around a central fireplace. Pots and pans are in the foreground, indicating a kitchen setting. Architectural elements like brickwork and wooden beams dominate the right side, with a doorway leading to another room. A large plume of smoke or steam rises from the fireplace or stove. Various kitchen implements and containers are scattered in the area. The lines suggest texture and depth, with the figures showing interaction within this detailed interior setting.

artworks.title: On ne s'avise jamais de tout
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior domestic scene. The drawing depicts three figures engaging in various activities near a hearth, with flames or smoke rising from the fireplace. The figures are dressed in 18th-century attire. In the background, through an open door, another figure can be seen walking outside. The room's decor includes pots, jugs, and other domestic items placed on the mantle above the fireplace. The drawing is highly detailed, showcasing expert shading and line work to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: On ne s'avise jamais de tout
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures engaged in domestic activities. The image depicts a richly detailed room with ornate decoration. The scene is centered around a hearth with smoke billowing out. Several figures are engaged in interaction, with dynamic postures and flowing garments. The space is filled with everyday items like pots and vessels. To the right, an open doorway shows a glimpse of an exterior setting. The drawing features intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Le gascon puni
artworks.artist: Louis-Michel Halbou and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with furniture and people pointing. The scene depicts a grand bed with an elaborately draped canopy in a lavish interior. The room is richly detailed, including a framed picture on the wall. The engraving style emphasizes shading and texture, capturing the folds of fabric and the carved details of the furniture. The composition includes figures with gestures and expressions, adding to the sense of drama and intrigue.

artworks.title: Le gascon puni
artworks.artist: Louis-Michel Halbou and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This image shows a scene with four individuals. There is a person partially lying on a bed, with their body extending towards two standing individuals beside the bed. The person on the bed has curly hair and is wearing a loose-fitting garment. Beside the bed, another person is dressed in a detailed gown, with elaborate hair adorned with accessories, accompanied by someone holding a torch. The fourth person is sitting upright in the bed, propped on one elbow, with tousled hair and wearing a similar garment as the person lying down. The setting includes a large, ornate canopy bed with heavy drapes and a high, decorated headboard, along with a framed painting in the background.

artworks.title: Le gascon puni
artworks.artist: Louis-Michel Halbou and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image consists of four individuals: one person is seated upright on a bed while the other three are standing. The seated figure on the bed is covered with bedding and has one arm raised towards their forehead. The standing figures include a man holding a torch, a woman with her back to the viewer in a long flowing dress, and another man leaning towards the bed pulling on the sheets. Facial features are detailed; the seated figure has curly hair and wide eyes. The standing woman's hair is ornately styled. The man holding the torch wears a coat over a shirt, and the other man is dressed in period clothing. The room includes a large canopy bed, draping curtains, and an ornate headboard. The background features a detailed painting on the wall depicting classical figures.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: La cassette
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seascape with a shipwreck scene. The image shows ocean waves crashing against rocky cliffs, with ships visible in the background. A fallen tree with branches reaching towards the sea is present. In the foreground, the composition includes two intertwined figures amidst the shipwreck debris. The detailed etching lines convey motion and texture in the waves and foliage.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: La cassette
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coastal scene. The image shows an ocean viewed from a rocky shore, with waves crashing against the rocks. In the foreground, two figures are engaged amidst the waves, with their clothing flowing. The background includes a cliff, a bending tree, ships on the sea, and a cloudy sky. The drawing features textured detailing to create a sense of motion and tension.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: La chevalier
artworks.description: The image features two individuals standing in a forest. The person on the left, a woman, is seated on the ground with her hand crossed over her chest. She has long hair, partially covered by a veil, and delicate facial features. She wears a long gown with intricate detailing and a belt. The person on the right, a man, is kneeling on one knee and leaning towards the woman. He has curly hair and is looking at the woman. His facial features are animated as he gestures with his hands. The man is dressed in armor with a sheathed sword and shield. In the background is a densely wooded forest with a horse standing beside them.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: La chevalier
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals sitting in a forested setting. On the left, a female figure sits with her body turned to the right, looking down at something in her hands. She has delicate facial features, wears a flowing gown with a veil, and a shawl around her. Beside her, a male figure kneels facing her, gesturing with his hands. He has curly hair and a strong profile, wearing a tunic, leggings, and a sword. In the background, trees and foliage surround the scene, with a horse partially visible among the grasses.
